Priya CSM: Quick sync before tomorrow's procurement call — Nora's team needs a copy-pasteable monthly SLA + credit formula (uptime + p95 latency) for finance. Renewal flagged if unclear.

Marco (SRE): Hosted baseline = 99.9% monthly uptime. We use monthly aggregation. Recommend deterministic Excel formulas and a worked example.

Nora (Buyer): Exactly — one Excel line they can paste into their TCO model. Also show Dedicated variant with stronger guarantees.

Jules - Solutions: Draft formulas (Excel-ready):
UptimeCreditPct = MAX(0, FLOOR((SLA - ObservedUptime) / 0.005) * 0.01)
LatencyDailyPct = CEILING(MAX(0, ObservedP95 - TargetP95) / 50, 1) * 0.005
LatencyCreditPct = MIN(0.10, SUM(LatencyDailyPct * (DaysExceeded / 30)))
CombinedPct = MIN(0.12, UptimeCreditPct + LatencyCreditPct)
FinalCredit = InvoiceAmount * CombinedPct

SLAbot: Account snapshot: observed_uptime=99.82, observed_p95=260, target_p95=150, days_exceeded=2

Jules - Solutions: Worked example (one line for Excel): Invoice=75000, CombinedPct -> 0.03, FinalCredit = 2250. (I'll attach a mini spreadsheet).

Marco (SRE): Ops note: Latency days are prorated by fraction of day where p95 exceeded threshold (monitoring uses daily buckets). For Hosted we can enable 30m auto-burst during spikes to reduce long windows.

Priya CSM: Action items: Jules to attach spreadsheet + one-pager comparing Hosted vs Dedicated, Marco to confirm proration rule text, I will send to Nora by EOD. Procurement deadline = Friday COB. Tagging as renewal-risk. :white_check_mark:
